text: UNBELIEVABLE. Some idiot in a white van came straight at me at the junction of Hagana and Herzl in Haifa, he cut the turn on the wrong side, headlights in my face, total head on. The road was soaking wet, it had just stopped raining, about 6:30pm. My Mazda 3 (2019) is not drivable, airbag out, the whole front is crumpled up to the windshield, ambulance took me for X-rays and my neck is killing me. 100% his fault, there are two witnesses who saw it. Call me NOW. תאונה קשה!

hi its me again. fog was SO thick on the highway this morning, around 7:40, cars braking everywhere. my silver toyota got shoved into the car ahead and then someone smashed into me from behind, 4 cars in total i think?? nobody knows who started it, police took notes. bumper and boot crushed but it still drives. no idea who is liable. туман был жуткий

Dear Sir or Madam, I wish to report an incident that occurred at approximately 2:15 pm on the Ben Yehuda pedestrian street in Tel Aviv, where delivery vehicles are permitted until 3 pm. It was a sunny day and the street was crowded. While manoeuvring my red Hyundai i10 between the tables, I brushed against a metal planter and a cafe chair. No person was hurt. There is a light scratch on the left front wing and the cafe owner has asked for the chair to be replaced. I accept responsibility for the incident and would like to know which documents I should submit.

Hey, so last night around 11pm on the ring road near Be'er Sheva me and another driver both decided to move into the same lane at the same time. שנינו התחלנו לעבור נתיב ביחד, honestly neither of us signalled properly and he says I didn't look, I say he was in my blind spot. My black Skoda Octavia 2016 has a broken right mirror and a long dent along the rear door and wing. Nobody injured. I think we are both a bit to blame.
got rear ended at the lights by some guy, rain pouring, 8am. my blue kia 2021 bumper cracked. his fault, he admitted. pls call

Backed my car into a neighbour's gate this afternoon in Jerusalem, did not see it, my bad. Small dent on the boot and his gate is bent a little. что делать дальше? do I call you first or the neighbour?

Came back from shopping at about 7pm and found a long scrape along the passenger side of my grey Renault Clio 2012 at the Ashdod mall parking lot. No note, nobody around, and I have no idea who did it or when, it could have happened any time while I was inside. I do not know if there are cameras. Paint is gone in two places but nothing is dented.

Please help i dont know what to do. Around midnight, sky totally clear, streets empty, I was tired and I drove through the red light at the intersection in Netanya and a car hit my BMW 2018 right in the driver's door. Door pushed in, side airbags went off, I couldn't open it and the fire brigade had to cut me out. I'm bruised but they say I'm ok. It's completely my fault, I just didn't see the light. אני מצטער, I know the damage is huge.

To whom it may concern, I am writing to submit a claim regarding a collision on Tuesday morning at roughly 9:05 in Ra'anana. The sky was grey and overcast but visibility was good and the road was dry. I was driving my white Volkswagen Golf through the intersection on the green light when a delivery car coming from the right did not stop at its stop sign and struck the passenger side of my vehicle. Both passenger doors are dented and the rear window is cracked, and the car can be driven but needs repair before it is safe. The other driver admitted at the scene that he did not see the sign and we exchanged details. A police officer arrived and wrote a short report. I attach photographs of the damage and kindly ask for your assessment of the repair costs.

Ok so about 5:45pm, thick fog, I'm in my green Ford Focus 2014 turning left at a junction and so is an oncoming car, we both crept forward because we couldn't see anything and bam, front to front, not fast but loud. הוא טוען שאני לא עצרתי, I say he didn't stop either. Fair to say we both misjudged it. Both bumpers off, radiator leaking, towed away. Nobody badly hurt.

I am FURIOUS. Yesterday around 3pm on the Rishon LeZion bypass it was pouring rain and the truck behind us never slowed down. He ploughed into the last car, which was pushed into the one in front of it, which pushed into MY black Honda Civic 2020 - five cars, one big pile. My car was squeezed between two others, boot and bonnet both destroyed, and the tow truck driver told me it is probably a write-off. I went to the hospital with back pain and a cut on my forehead. The truck driver was on his phone, I saw it with my own eyes, so everything is on him, 100 percent. I have photos, dashcam footage and the names of two other drivers. Why is nobody from your company calling me back? Это просто безобразие!

Reporting a hit on the Tiberias promenade at about 9:15 pm. I was driving slowly in the shared pedestrian zone by the lake in my orange 2017 car, the stones were all wet from the earlier rain, and a delivery scooter came out of the side lane too fast and slid into my front left door. Dent, scratched paint and the window won't go up now. Nobody was hurt, the scooter guy said sorry and left his number but didn't want to talk to the police.
